description: All G++ control candidates covering individual normative sentences of one official ED2023 Anforderung. Empty array if no sentence has a candidate.

satz_nr.description: The number n of the sentence (S n) of the Anforderung, per the numbering in the prompt.

control_id.description: The exact ID of the candidate G++ control, copied verbatim from the provided list (e.g. 'KONF.2.1').

begruendung.description: Short justification why this control covers exactly this sentence's demanded activity.
